rule: A cell may reach PROVEN_T2 only if it matches a pod here whose status is pre_registered. Pods must be declared before the forward data they will be judged on exists; a pod extracted from the results being judged is post_hoc and cannot promote. Everything unmatched is discovery.
note: This is the recommended addition to reports/audit3_confirmatory.json. All three pods follow the fund-manager playbook (07_FUND_MANAGER_PLAYBOOK.md) and use the literature-correct expression (vol-targeted, time/vol exit, no fixed TP).

status_meaning.pre_registered: may confer confirmatory; judged on forward rows from registered_at
status_meaning.post_hoc: recorded for the audit trail only; cannot confer confirmatory
status_meaning.declined: evaluated and rejected; recorded so nobody re-proposes it blind

pods.thesis: Time-series momentum / trend across 20-60 liquid futures (equity idx, bonds, FX, rates, commodities) or ETF proxies. Strongest documented premium with ~140 years of evidence and crisis alpha (Moskowitz-Ooi-Pedersen 2012; Hurst 100y).
pods.expression: Vol-scaled TSMOM: ensemble of 3-12m lookbacks, 40-60% portfolio vol target, monthly rebalance, symmetric time/vol exit. No TP/SL.
pods.acceptance_criteria: Forward rows after 2026-11-19: n>=100, net CI-LB > 0 at 2x measured slippage, IR>=0.5 vs matched benchmark (e.g. 60/40 or GSG/AGG blend), split-half stable. CI-LB<=0 at day 30/60 ends the pod.
pods.evidence_at_registration: FUTURES measured slippage 0.10-0.15% is at/above the 3x cost gate; use ETF proxies (DBMF/KMLM/HMF-style) if futures fills are too costly. Vol-targeting is the documented correct expression.

pods.thesis: G10 currency carry (long high-yield, short low-yield) with a trend overlay to cut carry-crash risk. Classic, documented premium (Lustig-Roussanov-Verdelhan).
pods.expression: Rank G10 by 1-3m forward discount (or rate differential); long top-3 / short bottom-3; vol-targeted; 200d trend overlay; monthly rebalance.
pods.acceptance_criteria: Forward rows after 2026-11-19: n>=100, net CI-LB > 0 at 2x measured slippage, IR>=0.5 (FX data must be backfilled first - series currently ends 2026-02-09). KILL if forward CI-LB <=0 at day 60.
pods.evidence_at_registration: FX carry is the one classic premium with existing plumbing (H21-H23 funding-carry work shows the pattern, small but real). Requires data backfill + >=3 walk-forward folds before promotion.

pods.thesis: Post-earnings-announcement drift on liquid large-caps: SUE-ranked earnings surprise, long +1 sigma surprise decile, 60-day hold. One of the most replicated anomalies (Bernard-Thomas 1989).
pods.expression: Screen 500+ names; SUE ranking; long +1sigma decile, avoid/negative shorts; 60-day hold; weekly rebalance; low turnover.
pods.acceptance_criteria: Forward rows after 2026-11-19: n>=100, net CI-LB > 0 at 2x measured slippage, IR>=0.5 vs SPY matched exposure. Requires the PEAD pipeline to be fixed first (existing 60/60 pipeline known broken).
pods.evidence_at_registration: PEAD is a small-per-event effect that needs breadth (500+ names); low turnover defeats the fee wall. Equity class is the only one with a positive after-cost win-rate margin (+2.9pp).
